messages:
maria: Night crew flagged a mismatch — reservation count for us-west-2 pool shows 12 in billing but 16 in the capacity plan. Can reservation owners confirm which is canonical? cc @kevin @josh

josh: Looking — I see `resv-uw2-2024-09` set to 16 in terraform state, billing shows 12. Possible partial release earlier. Did we run the reservation-reconcile job last night?

kevin: I disabled reconcile last week for the canary window. Oops, that explains it. I planned to re-enable after smoke. Who's running tonight's staging burn?

maria: @anika's team is doing staging burn from 00:30–02:00 PT. They reported failures on 4x instances. We held traffic, so reconcile didn't finish.

anika: Failures were disk pressure on the new racks (rack-7). We filed infra ticket INF-482, infra team is on it. We should avoid forced reconcile until disk issue is fixed.

ellie: Proposed plan: re-enable reconcile at 03:30 PT, but run a --dry-run first, then full reconcile at 04:00 PT if no regressions. Also post a heads-up to #eng-oncall.

josh: Sounds good. Can we allocate fallback capacity? If reconcile releases nodes we want to keep capacity for prod traffic. Suggest reserving a temporary 4-GPU buffer (reserve-temp-uw2-4).

prodops: I can create reserve-temp-uw2-4 for tonight. ETA ~20m. Will update billing tags so cost center is correct.

kevin: Also pinging deploy-bot: re-enable reconcile for us-west-2 with dry-run at 03:30 PT, then full at 04:00 PT with `--safety=rollback-window=15m`.

deploy-bot: @kevin Ack. Scheduled reconcile dry-run at 03:30 PT and full run at 04:00 PT with rollback-window=15m. I'll post status in this thread.

maria: Thanks all. Quick follow-ups: (1) @anika confirm INF-482 owner & ETA, (2) @prodops confirm reserve created, (3) @josh/ops confirm reconcile logs look ok after dry-run. I can take ownership of post-reconcile smoke.

anika: INF-482 assigned to ben (infra). ETA 02:15 PT for disk replacement. Will update here.

prodops: reserve-temp-uw2-4 created: `reserve-12345`. Tagged. Billing shows pending until 02:00 PT.

josh: Dry-run completed at 03:32 PT. Log snippet:
```
reconcile: would-release=4 would-claim=0
checks: canary-pass=true
```
No unexpected releases. Proceeding to full at 04:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Full reconcile started at 04:00 PT. Progress: 0/16 nodes released.

ellie: Post-run: reconcile kept 16 reserved, release prevented because reserve-12345 was active. No regressions seen. Marking this milestone closed.

maria: Awesome — I'll update the capacity spreadsheet and set milestone `night-handoff-uw2` to done. Thanks :tada:
